授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
● The reference papers used for lectures and class discussions are mainly selected from international academic journals and international research reports. Reference papers for each lecture will be distributed to the participants in advance.
● All students are requested to make class presentations based on reference materials.  (paper presentation by students  will start from the  late November)

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
● Firstly, we will review the recent trends in Asian economic development and discuss the features of Asian economic development.
● Then, the economic development process of Asian economies (Japan, China, etc.) and some main problems faced by this region will be discussed and analyzed in detail.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Asia, Economic Development, FDI, Trade, International Migration, Inequality, Sustainable Development, SDGs
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: ● This course is designed for students of the graduate school of economics. However, excellent undergraduate students are also welcome.
